contents_summary: Two-page PDF of supplementary tables. Table S1 gives, for 11 patients identified by patient number, the PCL-5 change, number of documented self-regulation strategies, primary strategy categories and representative strategies. Table S2 is a group-level comparison of multiple (>3) versus few (<=3) strategies. Both pages were rendered and viewed.

pages.contents: Page 1: "Supplementary Tables" heading; Table S1 (Individual Patient Strategy Development Profiles) with 11 patient rows and columns Patient, PCL-5 Change, Strategy Count, Primary Categories and Representative Strategies, followed by the note about documented strategy data (n=11); the title and first row of Table S2 (Multiple Strategy Development Analysis) begin at the bottom.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Patient-numbered strategy profiles for 11 patients; the row labels match the Table 6 patient numbers of the main article. The Table S2 part at the bottom is a group summary and is not typed here.
limitations: No printed rights notice or exception on the page; article source license retained without blanket relicensing.
Table S2 start on this page is group-level (n, ranges, mean change) and not assigned to any patient.

pages.contents: Page 2: continuation of Table S2 (Multiple Strategy Development Analysis) with a repeated header, an empty row, the few-strategies row (n 7, range 1-3, mean PCL-5 change 42.9 with SD 20.9), a Difference row (0.1, Cohen's d = 0.01) and an italic note on ranges and exploratory interpretation.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Group-level analysis statistics repeating figures given in the main article text and Figure 4 caption; no individual patient data, so no patient is assigned and no typed fact is recorded.
limitations: No printed rights notice or exception on the page.
Group statistics are not extracted as patient facts.
Table S1 values are transcribed from the rendered page; the printed quotation marks mix straight and curly forms and are kept as read.
Table S2 group statistics are not typed as patient facts.
